name: Arken Audio Codecs v1
description: Portable bounded memory-only audio codecs over a canonical integer PCM model: lossless WAV, FLAC and AIFF/AIFF-C (integer PCM preserved exactly; float and compressed WAV/AIFF-C rejected rather than quantized) and lossy Ogg Vorbis, Ogg Opus and MP3 (decoded at 16 bits with encoder delay and padding trimmed from container data; encoded with explicit, documented quality controls). The codec never opens files, reads stdio or starts threads.

external_dependencies.reason: Pinned BSD-3-Clause libFLAC library only (no GPL programs, no Ogg, no SIMD) for memory-only FLAC decoding and deterministic encoding.
Pinned BSD-3-Clause libogg page sync, CRC and packet framing for the bounded Ogg demuxer and the Vorbis/Opus muxers.
Pinned BSD-3-Clause libvorbis/libvorbisenc (no vorbisfile, no tools) for Vorbis decoding and deterministic VBR encoding.
Pinned BSD-3-Clause libopus float build without intrinsics, RTCD or DNN features for Opus decoding and deterministic encoding.
Pinned CC0 minimp3 header (Layer III only, no SIMD) for bounded MP3 decoding.
Pinned LGPL-2.0-or-later libmp3lame (no frontend, no mpglib decoder, no SIMD/NASM) for MP3 encoding with a LAME gapless tag.
